beats.hook: The surprising claim, said in the first sentence. [[title]]Then the question the video answers.
beats.s1: Section one opens with a short question.
beats.s1a: Say the first idea while the picture builds it. [[note]]The mark goes right before the word the animation waits for.
beats.s1b: Show a concrete example before the rule. [[rule]]Then state the rule in plain words.
beats.s2: Section two opens, and it picks up from the last payoff.
beats.s2a: A contrast carries interest: [[before]]what you expect, [[after]]and what actually happens.
beats.payoff: Land the point in one line. [[end]]Then stop on a button line.
